source_delta: Each child preserves its published A14 parent except description, the all-null OperationParameter placeholder changed to custom KM, and one added MissionTypeUtilization row for EXECUTE. Hourly variants configure 60 KM 1/HOUR. Per-mission variants configure 240 KM 1/MISSION, equivalent over the planned four-hour EXECUTE mission. Control/dependent inputs at the same rate differ only in the parent MissionDependence row and description.

configuration.execution: CONTINUOUS EXECUTE with one other aircraft, planned 8-12
configuration.dependent_abort: SUPPORT success at 10 aborts EXECUTE at 10 through one accepted CONTINUOUS MissionDependence row

pre_run_hypotheses: All four inputs import/export the author-supplied populated tables exactly, convert with zero errors, and preserve their respective accepted A14 control or dependent event timelines and terminal two-ready state.
The two control rate forms each yield cumulative EXECUTE KM SOACC=240 after its full 8-12 mission; the hourly dependent yields 120 for its active 8-10 interval.

If native 1/MISSION utilization is prorated by actual active time on dependency abort, dependent-mission SOACC will equal 120; if it is charged at a different point or amount, report the observed contrast and reject equivalence for that branch.

Operation report half-hour bins, total accumulated SOACC and 16-hour-horizon averages must reconcile with the observed events; zero failure, maintenance, resource and stock demand should remain unchanged from the parents.
acceptance_requires: exact source/parent lineage and four-way contrast, frozen before native execution
fresh guarded session-0 SSH import, export, calculation and valid output for each tested branch
zero conversion errors, source roundtrip, event/terminal/ledger reconciliation
valid MissionOperation report settings without loader fallback and raw closure hashes
separate read-only reviewer replay of every published claim
limits: This tests one deterministic CONTINUOUS dependency abort, not random failure, fixed/extendable mission partial exposure, or a mission suspended then resumed.
MissionOperation results are per selected unit, not per serial-numbered aircraft; no shared-formation per-aircraft disaggregation is claimed.
KM is an abstract user-defined unit rather than independently validated physical kilometres. Other seeds, GUI rendering and cross-engine parity remain unverified.
